inspection_summary: Inspected all 1,199 normalized lines. The article develops explicit critical-line zeta bounds by combining summation-formula representations, first- and second-derivative exponential-sum estimates, geometric block decompositions, Weyl differencing for the middle range, explicit coefficient bookkeeping, and range-specific final assembly. The prose and proof architecture are recoverable throughout, although many displayed formulas have text-layer layout damage and must be interpreted with their checked surrounding prose rather than as clean symbolic transcriptions.
